summary: Plan IT work, manage Agile backlogs, and prepare release records. Explore this five-day foundation course and strengthen your delivery practice.
lede: IT project management links delivery plans with software and service work for project coordinators, team leads, and aspiring project managers. You’ll practise defining scope and schedules, organizing prioritized Agile backlogs, tracking risks and change decisions, and preparing acceptance and service-transition records through practical project exercises.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who coordinate technology delivery or contribute to project decisions and need a practical way to link project plans with Agile team workflows.
outcomes: Critical Path And Earned Value Analysis
modules: IT Delivery Context and PMBOK Guide
Work Breakdown Structure and Schedule Logic
Scrum Guide Backlog and Sprint Planning
Kanban Method Flow and Work Limits
IT Risk, Change and Decision Logs
prerequisites: Working familiarity with IT team tasks, project stakeholders, or software and service delivery. No coding is required.
